sloka: ततस्तान् पूजितान् दृष्ट्वा रत्नैरर्थैश्च यूथपान् ।आरुरोह ततो रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।। ६.१२५.१२ ।।
transliteration: tatastān pūjitān dṛṣṭvā ratnairarthaiśca yūthapān ।āruroha tato rāmastadvimānamanuttamam ।। 6.125.12 ।।

translations.english: ﻿ Illustrious Vaidehi was abashed while she was taken in his(Hanuman’s) arms to Pushpalata while the valiant archers Lakshmana and his brother were there .
